info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Tax Management API
info.description: The Customer Tax Management API facilitates the efficient handling of customer tax information within banking operations. This API allows businesses to submit, update, and manage tax-related data for individual consumers effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and tax compliance software developers, who need to integrate robust tax solutions into their services. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline compliance processes and enhance customer service through accurate tax information management.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and manage tax handling configurations for consumers. It enables businesses to ensure compliance with tax regulations and streamline financial processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to handle customer tax operations by submitting the necessary data in JSON format. The data provided should include all relevant customer tax details as specified in the schema.
